Description: Loads PDFs or crawls websites, extracts text, and splits into manageable chunks.
Converts text chunks into embeddings using OpenAIEmbeddings(model="text-embedding-3-small").
Stores embeddings in InMemoryVectorStore and maintains them in st.session_state.
Retrieves relevant document chunks based on user queries (vectorstore.as_retriever).
Sends the query and retrieved context to the OpenAI model (client.chat.completions.create) to generate grounded answers.
